title: 第14章 小鱼儿第15章 财多多
lines: 青甲男子假装翻了翻册子
"小子，你是怎么进来的，是不是忘记交什么东西了"男子立马佯装生气拔剑
"这个够么"
只见周岐摸出一块七彩石头
"法髓！"
男子突然惊呼，周围所有人都露出贪婪的神色，但是青甲男子露出思索之色，立马热情向前
"你说我这眼睛，真是眼拙了，竟没有认出公子，公子随意，有什么事尽管报我的名字"男子拍着胸脯答道
"你认识我？"
男子突然露出尴尬的神色，"呵，当然，不就是…公子嘛"男子小声嘀咕了一下
周岐也是被逗笑了
"刚才听你在这说话，可是发生什么事了"
"小事小事"见男子没想说，周岐也转身离开
"叶少，你怎么放他走了，法髓啊，我长这么大还没见过呢"其中一名守卫向前连忙问道
"蠢货，法髓是一般人能有的吗，什么猪脑子，要是惹错人都没地方哭"
"说不定是他运气好……"
"你是统领我是统领！继续找人"
周岐望着周围宫殿，突然在一个角落他看见了一个人影
"小鱼儿，你怎么在这？"人影本来一慌，看见周岐后立马匆匆跑了过来
"大哥哥是你！"
"你在躲什么？"
"娘亲，大哥哥救救我娘亲"小鱼儿说着潸然泪下
"怎么回事，你跟我说"周岐伸出手摸头安慰着
"大哥哥你走后，娘亲说去买点凳子，下次有客人来就有地方坐了，然后今天碰到了姓柳的，就把我娘抓走了"小鱼儿抽泣痛哭
"姓柳的，他抓你娘干什么"
"他是大坏人，他说我娘有什么血脉，就抓走了"
周岐牵着小鱼儿的手
"知道在哪里吗，带我过去"本来小鱼儿正露出欢喜神色，立马又犹豫了
"大哥哥，我不能害你…"
"没事，带我去吧，有我"
听着周岐充满安全感的话语小鱼儿终于拉着周岐小跑奔向某处
斩仙天宫柳府
柳府，斩仙天宫宫主府邸，也是后来斩仙殿所设传法处
在柳府府邸内，院子之中汇聚这一群凡人，而他们面前伫立着两道人影
"少爷，都在这里了"其中一名男子躬身向着他面前的男子答复
另一名男子身着一袭暗红色锦袍，衣襟敞开露出结实的胸膛。长发披肩，脖子戴着一枚血色玉坠。眉眼狭长，眼尾上挑，笑容中带着几分玩世不恭
"他们真的有用？凡人而已要不放了算了"男子望着眼前随意开口
"这是老爷吩咐，奴才也只是帮衬少爷抓人"
突然一道巨响，男子立马神色一冷
"那个家伙敢打扰本少爷雅兴"
男子还未走到门口便看见巨门倒在门边，随即他就看到了一大一小两道身影，看到小一点的身影他立马一笑
"小爷我还没来抓你就送上门了"说罢就要上前
周岐走了出来，男子也停下
content_en:
The man in blue armor pretended to flip through the book
"Boy, how did you get in? Did you forget to hand over something?" The man immediately pretended to be angry and drew his sword.
"Is this enough?"
I saw Zhou Qi take out a colorful stone
"Dharma Essence!"
The man suddenly exclaimed, and everyone around him looked greedy, but the man in green armor looked thoughtful and immediately moved forward enthusiastically.
"You said my eyes are really stupid. I didn't recognize the young master. You're free to say that. If you have any problem, just tell me my name." The man replied, patting his chest.
"You know me?"
The man suddenly showed an embarrassed look, "Oh, of course, he's just...Young Master," the man muttered in a low voice.
Zhou Qi was also amused
"I just heard you talking here, but what happened?"
"It's a small matter." Seeing the man, Zhou Qi didn't want to say anything, so he turned around and left.
"Master Ye, why did you let him go? Dharma Essence, I have never seen him in my whole life." One of the guards stepped forward and asked quickly.
"Idiot, is the Dharma Essence accessible to ordinary people? What a pig brain. If you offend the wrong person, you won't have a place to cry."
"Maybe he's lucky..."
"You are the commander and I am the commander! Keep looking for people"
Zhou Qi looked around the palace, and suddenly he saw a figure in a corner.
"Xiao Yu'er, why are you here?" The figure was originally panicked, but immediately ran over after seeing Zhou Qi.
"You are the big brother!"
"What are you hiding from?"
"Mother, big brother, please save my mother," Xiao Yu'er said with tears streaming down her face.
"What's going on? Tell me." Zhou Qi reached out and touched his head to comfort him.
"Brother, after you left, my mother said to buy some stools so that we can have a place to sit next time guests come over. Then today, we met someone named Liu and took my mother away." Xiao Yuer sobbed and cried bitterly.
"Liu, why did he arrest your mother?"
"He is a big bad guy. He said that my mother had some bloodline, so he took her away."
Zhou Qi holds Xiao Yuer's hand
"Do you know where it is? Take me there." Xiao Yu'er looked happy at first, but he hesitated immediately.
"Brother, I can't harm you..."
"It's okay, take me there, I'll be there"
Listening to Zhou Qi's words full of security, Xiao Yu'er finally pulled Zhou Qi and ran towards somewhere.
Kill Immortal Heavenly Palace Liu Mansion
Liu Mansion, the residence of the master of the Zhanxian Tiangong Palace, was also the place where Zhanxian Palace later set up a teaching place.
In the Liu Mansion, a group of mortals gathered in the courtyard, and two figures stood in front of them.
"Master, they are all here." One of the men bowed and replied to the man in front of him.
The other man was wearing a dark red brocade robe, with the skirt open to reveal his strong chest. Her long hair is shawl, and she wears a blood-colored jade pendant around her neck. The eyebrows are long and narrow, the ends of the eyes are raised, and there is a bit of cynicism in the smile.
"Are they really useful? We're just mortals, so why don't we let them go?" the man said casually as he looked in front of him.
"This is the master's order, and the slave is only helping the master to arrest people."
"Bang!"
Suddenly there was a loud noise, and the man immediately looked cold.
"That guy dares to disturb my young master's elegance."
Before the man reached the door, he saw the giant door falling beside it. Then he saw two figures, one large and one small. When he saw the smaller figure, he immediately smiled.
"Master, I sent you to your door before I came to arrest you." After saying that, he stepped forward.
Zhou Qi walked out and the man stopped.
title_en: Chapter 14 Little Fish Chapter 15 Lots of Money
